title: Richard Feynman Lecture -- "Los Alamos From Below"
summary: A 78-minute Richard Feynman lecture of anecdotes about working at Los Alamos on the Manhattan Project, followed by about ten minutes of audience Q&A in which he tells three safe-cracking stories.
why: Strongly recommended for its funny, human account of Los Alamos, which one commenter calls almost a stand-up act.

quote.text: He gives an incredible account of his time there in the lecture (and almost stand-up-comedy act)
